title: 第1章 仙秦镇抚司第2章 武道九重境
slug: 镇守仙秦地牢吞妖六十年
content_zh:
庐阳府。
镇抚司。
仙秦九洲之地，一手镇压世间仙妖邪魔，一手抚慰天下官员百姓，生死独断，直达天听，是为镇抚司。
巍峨森冷的镇抚司门口，两座丈高青石狮之前。
一位身高八尺有余，腰背挺拔，穿皂袍，扎黑带，手按雁翎刀的青年深吸一口气，大步走上十三层石阶。
他叫张远，今天是第一日来镇抚司报到。
张远一家世代生活在庐阳府，父母早亡，大哥张振供职镇抚司，三月前殉职，张远处理过大哥的后事，就来镇抚司顶职。
仙秦军职，父死子承，兄死弟及。
踏上十三层石阶，头顶是镇抚司三个古拙大字，字字如斗，暗透金光。
丈高门庭之前，几道身影挺立。
“张远，我们与你大哥张振是袍泽兄弟，本该照顾你，但镇抚司有镇抚司的规矩。”说话之人身穿黑色武服，手按雁翎刀柄，一身煞气。
旗官孙泽，是张远大哥的顶头上司，如果张远能成皂衣卫，也会是张远的顶头上官。
“通过考验，你往后就是我们的生死兄弟，穿皂衣，执雁翎，天下之事皆可管。”
“要是通不过考验，那我们会帮你成家立业，娶妻生子，不让你张家香火断绝。”
“你准备好了吗？”
张远点点头，按住腰间雁翎的手掌握紧。
张家世代皂衣卫，他张远从晓事起就为这一天做准备！
旗官孙泽摆摆手，一位同样穿着皂衣，身形矮胖的中年引着张远走进镇抚司大门。
穿过威严的大堂，走过宽阔的广场，青石板上的脚步声越发沉闷。
张远微微握紧刀柄，压低声音：“全武哥，这试炼到底是什么？”

张全武，就是领着张远去是试炼之地的皂衣卫。
听到张远的话，张全武回头，目光落在张远腰间的雁翎刀上，轻笑一声：“杀人。”
杀人！
张远浑身一颤。
“镇抚司生死独断，司狱之中那些罪证确凿的，都会明正典刑。”
张全武伸手做出一个劈砍的动作。
镇抚司分武镇和文抚两司。
武镇司缉拿追捕，镇压擒杀，雁翎刀天下胆寒。
文抚司则是一应罪责判定，生死皆在一笔勾划之间。
所有文抚司判定死罪之人，镇抚司会发放行刑任务。
张远的试炼，或者说每一位镇抚司新人的试炼任务，就是杀人。
没杀过人，没有资格成为皂衣卫。
穿过长长的幽暗甬道，前方豁然开阔。
四面高墙，方圆十丈，庄重而肃穆。
头顶一半是牵伸的屋檐翘脚，一半是三尺高的石台，石台斑驳青黑。
石台上此时跪着一道身影，手足都已经被铁链锁住。
前方的屋宇下是一方长案，两排持刀武卒挺立，一位穿着青色袍服的人坐在长案后。
青袍长衫，这是修儒的文士。
文抚司的人。
“点司大人，今日刑使带到。”张全武恭敬的躬身，一边给张远使个眼色。
content_en:
Luyang Mansion.
Zhenfu Division.
In the land of Xian Qin Jiuzhou, he suppresses the immortals and demons in the world with one hand, and comforts the officials and people of the world with the other hand. He makes decisions about life and death directly to the heaven, which is the Zhenfusi.
At the gate of the majestic and cold Zhenfu Division, there are two blue stone lions standing in front of two feet high.
A young man who was more than eight feet tall, with a straight back, wearing a soap robe and a black belt, holding a wild goose feather knife in his hand, took a deep breath and strode up the thirteen stone steps.
His name is Zhang Yuan, and today is his first day to report to Zhenfu Division.
Zhang Yuan's family has lived in Luyang Mansion for generations. His parents died young. His eldest brother Zhang Zhen worked in the Town and Fu Division. He died in the line of duty three months ago. Zhang Yuan had handled his eldest brother's funeral and came to take up the post in the Town and Fu Division.
The military position of Immortal Qin is inherited by the son after the death of the father, and by the younger brother after the death of the elder brother.
Stepping onto the thirteen stone steps, above your head are the three ancient Chinese characters of Zhenfusi. The characters are like buckets, with a dark golden light.
In front of the Zhanggao Gate, several figures stood upright.
"Zhang Yuan, your eldest brother Zhang Zhen and we are Pao Ze brothers. We should take care of you, but the Zhenfu Division has its own rules." The speaker was wearing a black military uniform, holding his hand on the hilt of the Yan Ling sword, and was filled with evil aura.
Flag officer Sun Ze is the immediate superior of Zhang Yuan's eldest brother. If Zhang Yuan can become a Zaoyi guard, he will also be Zhang Yuan's immediate superior.
"If you pass the test, you will be our brother of life and death from now on. You will wear a soap coat, hold a wild goose feather, and be able to manage all affairs in the world."
"If you fail the test, then we will help you start a family, marry a wife and have children, and prevent your Zhang family from being cut off."
"Are you ready?"
Zhang Yuan nodded and tightened his grip on Yan Ling's waist.
The Zhang family has been guarding the country for generations, and Zhang Yuan has been preparing for this day since dawn!
Flag Officer Sun Ze waved his hand, and a short and fat middle-aged man also wearing soap clothes led Zhang Yuan into the gate of the Zhenfu Division.
After passing through the majestic lobby and the wide square, the footsteps on the bluestone became duller.
Zhang Yuan clenched the handle of the knife slightly and lowered his voice: "Brother Quan Wu, what exactly is this trial?"
Zhang Quanwu was the Zaoyi guard who led Zhang Yuan to the place of trial.
Hearing Zhang Yuan's words, Zhang Quanwu turned around, his eyes fell on the Yanling knife at Zhang Yuan's waist, and chuckled: "Kill."
Kill!
Zhang Yuan trembled all over.
"The Zhenfu Division has the final say on life and death, and those in the prison who have conclusive evidence of their crimes will be punished."
Zhang Quanwu stretched out his hand and made a chopping motion.
The Zhenfu Division is divided into two divisions: Wuzhen and Wenfu.
Wu Zhensi hunted, suppressed, captured and killed, and the Yanling Sword was feared all over the world.
The Wenfu Division is responsible for the judgment of guilt, and life and death are all determined by a stroke.
For all persons sentenced to death by the Civil and Fu Division, the Town and Fu Division will issue execution tasks.
Zhang Yuan's trial, or the trial task of every newcomer to the Zhenfu Division, is to kill people.
If you have never killed anyone, you are not qualified to be a Zaoyi guard.
After passing through the long dark corridor, the front suddenly opens up.
It is surrounded by high walls, ten feet in diameter, solemn and solemn.
Half of the top of the head is the stretched eaves and the raised legs, and the other half is a three-foot-high stone platform, which is mottled with green and black.
A figure was kneeling on the stone platform, and his hands and feet were chained.
Under the house in front is a long desk, with two rows of sword-wielding soldiers standing upright, and a man wearing a blue robe sitting behind the long desk.
Green robe and long gown, this is a scribe practicing Confucianism.
People from the Wenfu Department.
"Lord Dian Si, today the punishment envoy will be brought here." Zhang Quanwu bowed respectfully and winked at Zhang Yuan.
